page.content:
When the universe was first created, there were ten suns. The archer Hou Yi shot down nine of those suns, and they were all transformed into hotsprings. Purgation Spring is one of these nine hotsprings.

page.overview:
What is Purgation Spring?

When the universe was first created, there were ten suns. The archer Hou Yi shot down nine of those suns, and they were all transformed into hotsprings. Purgation Spring is one of these nine hotsprings.
